title: Bike Lights in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin sunset moves from 19:55 on 1 September to 18:47 on 30 September**, and the clocks take another hour on **25 October**, when sunset drops from 17:52 to 16:50.

**The legal trigger is twilight, not darkness.** StVO §17 asks for lights "bei Dämmerung", so you are inside the window from the moment the sun is down. In late September that grey zone runs about **34 minutes** past sunset.
**A typical 18:30 ride home loses the sun on 8 October** and the last twilight on **24 October**, which is around **170 evenings** before the daylight comes back at the end of March.

**The biggest danger is a driver turning across you.** Berlin police recorded **1,463 turning errors against cyclists in 2025**, close to three times the cyclists' own top cause of 512. Your front light is the one facing that driver.

**Legal lights carry a wavy line, the letter K and a number** from the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt. Battery and rechargeable lights are fine on any bicycle since 2017, but **flashing front or rear lights are prohibited**. Turn indicators became legal in June 2024.
**The fine ladder is 20, 25 and 35 euro**: missing or unlit, with endangerment, and where it contributed to an accident. Lights that are fitted but dirty, covered or switched off count as missing.

**Tempelhofer Feld closes at 21:30 through September and at 19:00 from 1 October.** Two and a half hours disappear overnight, so any route across the Feld has to go round it from the first day of the month.
